title: JONES-19: A Cultural Image Dataset Based on The Grammar of Ornament
abstract: arXiv:2611.30558v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce JONES-19, a high-quality image dataset documenting 1,901 ornament designs belonging to nineteen human cultures. The images and their annotations are based on an open access archive of The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1856), by Owen Jones. The dataset poses numerous challenges as a benchmark for computer vision classification tasks and for research at the intersection of machine learning and art and design: a small sample size, image samples of human-designed artifacts rather than common objects in-context or natural scenes, imbalanced class distribution, and image distinctions based on fine details involving line patterns, reliefs, and colors. As a design-inspired dataset, JONES-19 can serve as a benchmark for various research fields, such as visual recognition, data-efficient learning, art-historical research, architectural style analysis, and cultural heritage. translated_title: JONES-19：基于《装饰的法则》的文化图像数据集
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了JONES-19，这是一个高质量的图像数据集，记录了属于十九个人类文化的1,901个装饰纹样设计。这些图像及其标注基于Owen Jones所著《装饰的法则》（伦敦，1856年）的开放获取档案。该数据集作为计算机视觉分类任务以及机器学习与艺术设计交叉研究的基准，带来了诸多挑战：样本量小、图像样本是人类设计的人造物而非情境中的常见物体或自然场景、类别分布不均衡，以及图像间的差异依赖于涉及线条图案、浮雕和色彩等细微细节。作为一个源于设计领域的数据集，JONES-19可以作为多个研究领域的基准，例如视觉识别、数据高效学习、艺术史研究、建筑风格分析和文化遗产研究。本文描述了JONES-19数据集的构建过程。
tldr: 该论文提出了JONES-19数据集——一个基于1856年《装饰的法则》开放档案、涵盖十九种人类文化共1,901个装饰纹样设计的高质量图像数据集，为视觉识别、数据高效学习、艺术史研究与文化遗产等多个领域提供了具有挑战性的基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces JONES-19, a high-quality image dataset of 1,901 ornament designs from nineteen human cultures based on the 1856 open-access archive of The Grammar of Ornament, serving as a challenging benchmark for visual recognition, data-efficient learning, art-historical research, and cultural heritage studies.
